label: Get instance values
description: Read the values one instance was given for the program's `@instance_filled` fields. A field never given is absent from the result (runs use its fallback or default).

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: Keyed by `node.field`, the same keys `SetInstanceValues` takes: `{"answer.model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat", "digest.cron": "0 0 7 * * *"}`. A connection reads as its `{"id", "identity"}` handle.
